'''Z9''' was a [[R5-series astromech droid]] owned by [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]].

==History==
Z9 was present aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|space station]] housing the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]] when a hijacked [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] rigged with [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] was speeding towards them. When the Venator did not slow down, Z9 attempted to make contact with the captain of that ship but could not. Z9 later witnessed, along with the rest of the crew on board, the [[Carida Incident|destruction]] of [[Renown/Legends|the cruiser]].

==Appearances==
*{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}} {{1st}}
